summary: In this Goodful episode, hosts Merle and Catalina explore vegan tacos in Los Angeles, beginning with a visit to East Hollywood's vegan Mexican spot El Cocinero and then returning to the studio to build their own vegan tacos. The show contrasts authentic, bold flavors with plant-based substitutions, detailing jackfruit as a meat substitute and hibiscus-based meat, plus a vegan consommé. Viewers watch spice-toasting, marination, and long-simmer techniques, plus banana-leaf and foil moisture-management, before assembling tortillas with toppings like vegan cheese, cilantro, onions, avocado, and lime. A tasting sequence compares studio creations to a LA taco benchmark, followed by viewer-engagement prompts and closing remarks.
